dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Anti-GAD65 autoimmune stiff-person syndrome (stiff-limb–predominant variant), associated with diabetes mellitus

ALTERNATIVE 1: Bilateral lower-extremity osteoarthritis, likely related to obesity

ALTERNATIVE 2: Diabetic lumbosacral radiculoplexus neuropathy (diabetic amyotrophy)

ALTERNATIVE 3: Peripheral vascular disease causing intermittent claudication
